facts.fact: The finance committee's report of 5 July 2024 records MPs asking whether the bill's new cyberspace control body would duplicate the existing national information systems security agency (ANSSI), treating ANSSI as an existing national body.
facts.system: ANSSI (Agence nationale de securite des systemes d'information)

systems.country_label: Agence nationale de securite des systemes d'information

facts.fact: The National Assembly's finance committee (COMFIB) gave a favourable opinion on 5 July 2024 for adoption of the bill on information systems security (dossier no. 096), which sets up a body to control and protect national cyberspace and provides sanctions without prison terms.
facts.system: Projet de loi portant securite des systemes d'information
